# --opt minify=true runs the inline JS through esbuild minify flags and
# strips whitespace+comments from the surrounding HTML. We compile the same
# source twice (baseline + minified) and check the minified output is smaller
# and lacks indentation/comments while still containing the bundled JS body.

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=base app.sngl
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --opt minify=true --out=min app.sngl

exists base/index.html
exists min/index.html

# Baseline keeps the SNGL header comment and indented markup.
grep '<!-- ' base/index.html
grep '  <meta' base/index.html

# Minified output drops the SNGL header comment.
! grep '<!-- ' min/index.html

# Minified output has no leading indent before <meta>.
! grep '  <meta' min/index.html

# Baseline preserves source identifiers `a` and `b` and the IIFE arrow has spaces.
grep 'a \+ b' base/index.html
grep '\(\(\) => \{' base/index.html

# Minified output: identifiers are renamed and IIFE arrow has no spaces.
grep '\(\(\)=>\{' min/index.html
# A function with two single-letter params returning their sum survives.
grep 'function [a-z]\([a-z],[a-z]\)\{return [a-z]\+[a-z]\}' min/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"
import lib "js://./lib"

component main {
    var n = 0.0
    button(text="add", @click { n = lib.add(2.0, 3.0) })
    text(value=string(n))
}
-- lib/index.ts --
export function add(a: number, b: number): number {
    return a + b;
}
